messages.content: What do you mean by invalidation exactly? Are you saying that when a run completes or whatever that will no longer be able to use the new agent manager and point to get information about that agent? If so, I’m not sure if that’s the right move. I feel like you should still be able to learn about the agent even if the run already happened but maybe you’re talking about something completely different and I’m just confused of so could you just clarify what you’re talking about?
